claim: 商羯罗活跃于8世纪，是三始（prasthānatrayī：《奥义书》《梵经》《薄伽梵歌》）的最早完整存世注疏作者；是不二论的体系化者而非创始人
locator: SEP Shankara 引言："flourished during the eighth century CE"；"He composed our earliest complete extant commentaries on the Brahmasūtras, Bhagavadgītā, and the ten principal Upaniṣads"；维基 Systematizer 节："He is often considered to be the founder of the Advaita Vedānta school, but was actually a systematizer, not a founder"
note: SEP 另言商羯罗'被视为古典期最权威的不二论哲学家'；三始结构由 SEP 明文：三组文本'constitute Advaita Vedānta's triple canon (prasthānatrayī)'
uncertainty: 生卒具体纪年（788—820 等）无本包已核来源支持，只写'8世纪盛年'

claim: 师承谱系：商羯罗之师为 Govinda，据传统 Govinda 之师为乔荼波陀（约6世纪），作《Gauḍapādakārikā》；乔荼波陀之前不二论史料晦暗
locator: SEP Shankara："Śaṅkara's teacher was named Govinda; and according to tradition, Govinda's teacher was Gauḍapāda (sixth century CE), who composed the Gauḍapādakārikās"；IEP §History："the only two names that could have some historical certainty are Gaudapāda and Govinda Bhagavadpāda, mentioned as Śaṅkara's teacher's teacher and the latter Śaṅkara's teacher"
note: 两处均明示这是传统口径（according to tradition）而非史实定论
uncertainty: 乔荼波陀年代维基另有7世纪一说（'the Māndūkya-kārikā written by Gauḍapāda (7th century)'）

claim: 《Māṇḍūkya Kārikā》是现存最早完整的不二论文本
locator: 维基 Gauḍapāda 节："Of the ancient literature related to Advaita Vedānta, the oldest surviving complete text is the Māṇḍukya Kārikā"；GRETIL 文本实存并核读（标题："Gauḍapāda: Āgamaśāstra (= Gauḍapādakārikā...)"；版本 Apate, Pune 1921, Anandasrama Sanskrit Series 10）
note: IEP 亦称其为'第一本完整的不二论著作'（"The first complete Advaitic work is considered to be the Mandukya Kārikā"）

claim: 不二论系谱回溯至《梵经》作者跋达罗衍那（约前1世纪传统口径），三始构成经典基座
locator: SEP Shankara："Advaita Vedāntins trace their lineage back through Bādarāyaṇa (ca. first century BCE), who authored the Brahmasūtras"；"The corresponding texts of the Upaniṣads, Bhagavadgītā, and Brahmasūtras constitute Advaita Vedānta's triple canon (prasthānatrayī)"
note: SEP 以'不二论者追溯其系谱'的转述语气给出该纪年，属传统系谱框架；现代编成年代分歧未由本包来源细载，已入 evidenceLimits
uncertainty: 《梵经》现代定年区间本包未核来源，不写

claim: 梵我同一的论证之一：sat/asat 判据在认知的'不偏离'（avyabhicāra），变异形态之识偏离故属非存在一面
locator: GRETIL《薄伽梵歌》+注 节标 ||bhg_2.16||：颂"nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ / ubhayor api dṛṣṭo 'ntas tv anayos tattva-darśibhiḥ"；商羯罗注："yad-viṣayā buddhir na vyabhicarati, tat sat | yad-viṣayā vyabhicarati, tad asat"；SEP §2.1 引 BrSū 2.1.15、ChU 6.2.2、BhG 2.16 论存在自证与无形式根基
note: SEP §2.1 的'存在无形式、不二者'形上学与 BG 2.16 注的判据论证互证

claim: 意识非意向性论题与深睡论证：正理—胜论反对商羯罗的深睡意识持续说
locator: SEP Shankara §3："This was a matter of great debate between Advaita Vedānta and rival philosophies like Nyāya-Vaiśeṣika"；"one cannot claim direct perception of unconsciousness in deep sleep"；深睡中"ego and agency resolve into an unmanifest state and subject-object distinctions collapse"而意识无缝延续
note: 同节以见证意识的自立（self-established）回应无穷倒退质疑，引 BrSūBh 2.2.28、BṛUBh 4.3.7

claim: mahāvākya'汝即彼'（ChU 6.8.7）与'我即梵'（BṛU 1.4.10）；四个大语句的集中讨论系商羯罗之后不二论者所为；anvaya-vyatireka 等释经法
locator: SEP Shankara §5："Mahāvākyas like 'I am Brahman' (BṛU 1.4.10: ahaṃ brahmāsmi) or 'You are that' (ChU 6.8.7: tat tvam asi)"；"(Post-Śaṅkara Advaitins focused on four such 'great sentences')"；方法："continuity and discontinuity (anvaya and vyatireka), secondary indication (lakṣaṇā), and negative language (neti neti)"
note: SEP：商羯罗本人未把三种方法分开编目，其基本方法最宜描述为 anvaya-vyatireka（引 GKBh 13.13）

claim: adhyāsa（叠加）：自与非自相互误叠，绳蛇为喻；《梵经注》开篇有专论'叠加注'
locator: SEP Shankara §3："like mistaking a rope for a snake conceals its rope nature. (See Śaṅkara's seminal discussion of superimposition in his introduction to the BrSū titled, the 'Commentary on Superimposition' [Adhyāsabhāṣya])"；IEP §Error：adhyāsa bhāṣya 是'his preamble to the commentary on the Brahma Sūtra'
note: IEP 同时录商羯罗对错觉的两重刻画（梵文原文见该页）："smṛtirūpaḥ paratra pūrvadṛṣṭaḥ avabhāsaḥ"与"anyasya anyadharma-avabhāsatam"

claim: avidyā 无始且是一切生存苦难之根；追问无明起源即以无明求无明
locator: SEP Shankara §3："The epistemic failure of mutual superimposition is caused by ignorance (avidyā). Śaṅkara identifies avidyā as the root cause of all existential suffering"；IEP："Śaṅkara described avidya as beginningless. He considered that to search the origin of avidya itself is a process founded on avidya and hence will be fruitless"

claim: māyā 的宇宙面（samaṣṭi，属 īśvara）与个体面（vyaṣṭi，即各 jīva 的 avidyā）；īśvara 不受 māyā 制约而 jīva 受无明压伏
locator: IEP："Māyā has both individual (vyaśti) and cosmic (samaśti) aspects. The cosmic aspect belongs to one īśvara, and the individual aspect, avidya, belongs to many jīvas... īśvara is not controlled by māyā, whereas the jīva is overpowered by avidya"

claim: 'māyāvādin'是论敌贬称；商羯罗本人罕用 māyā 一词
locator: SEP Shankara §2.2："His philosophical adversaries pejoratively labeled him a māyāvādin... it misrepresents his intention... and ignores the fact that he infrequently uses the term 'māyā' (see Hacker 1995)"；维基 Criticisms 节：论敌"sometimes referring to the Advaita tradition as Māyāvāda"
note: SEP 另强调商羯罗重视道德德性与利世之行（引 BhGBh ch.3）

claim: anirvacanīya：世界既非梵亦非梵外之物的第三种存在地位（'次于真实'的显现）
locator: SEP Shankara §2.2："The universe of names and forms holds a unique ontological position as indeterminable (anirvacanīya) as brahman or something else other than brahman (BrSūBh 2.1.14, 2.1.17; GK 2.34; see Comans 2000)"；同节："unreal in that they are transient and dependent; yet are not non-existent like the horn of a hare"
note: GK 2.34 原文（GRETIL GpK_2.34："nānedaṃ na svenāpi kathaṃcana / na pṛthaṅ nāpṛthak kiṃcid iti tattvavido viduḥ"）已核读，与 SEP 引用对上

claim: 二谛：经验存在（vyāvahārikasattā）与终极存在（pāramārthikasattā）的不对称两层
locator: SEP Shankara §2.2："a two-tiered (or two truths or two orders) approach to reality: (1) The conventional intersubjective empirical reality (vyāvahārikasattā)... and (2) the ultimate reality (pāramārthikasattā) of nondual existence that is brahman"
note: 同节：经验层是'provisional ontology'，胜义视角'最终吞没世界及其因果与显现地位'

claim: 解脱论：śruti 为主、辅以 yukti 与 anubhava；mokṣa 是知的果；商羯罗以'实用的知'回应'自我不可能成为知识对象'的难题
locator: IEP §Liberation 相关节："in addition to Śruti, one requires yukti (reason) and anubhava (personal experience) to actualize knowledge of Brahman. Mokṣa... is the result of knowledge of Brahman"；同节：商羯罗把解脱所需之知视为'practical knowledge that removes ignorance'
note: SEP 引言亦记教学次第："learning methods of listening, reflection, and contemplation"，其目标是"a direct liberating recognition of nonduality"

claim: jīvanmukti：已悟者因现行业报未尽而继续生活；经证 ChUbh 6.14.2；魔术师喻
locator: SEP Shankara §6："like a magician who remains unconfused despite perceiving their own magical illusions... This lasts according to the ongoing fructification of karma in their present birth (ChUbh 6.14.2). One who is 'living while liberated' (jīvanmukti)"

claim: 不二论与佛教的归属争论：现代学界通说认为乔荼波陀受佛教影响（含术语借用）但是吠檀多论师非佛教徒
locator: 维基 Buddhist influences 节："Modern scholarship generally accepts that Gauḍapāda was influenced by Buddhism, at least in terms of using Buddhist terminology to explain his ideas, but adds that Gauḍapāda was a Vedantin and not a Buddhist"
note: 同节并录 Isaeva（商羯罗吸收了奥义书中未细化的佛教 māyā 观念）与 Dasgupta 的强影响说、以及传统一侧'拒绝隐蔽佛教指控'的立场——分歧如实并陈
uncertainty: 学术内部分歧（Mudgal：强调之别；Dasgupta：大量借用）未裁决，正文只写通说+争论存在

claim: 曼陀纳·弥湿罗是商羯罗的年长同时代人，出身弥曼差（伐多支，随瞿弥罗），兼写不二论纲领《Brahma-siddhi》；10世纪前其地位高于商羯罗
locator: 维基 Maṇḍana Miśra 节："an older contemporary of Shankara, was a Mimamsa scholar and a follower of Kumarila, but also wrote a seminal text on Advaita... the Brahma-siddhi"；"For a couple of centuries he seems to have been regarded as 'the most important representative of the Advaita position'"；IEP：曼陀纳为8世纪，出 Bhāṭṭa Mīmāṃsā，主知业并重而商羯罗唯知
note: 维基同节：《Brahma-siddhi》的错误论'became the normative Advaita Vedanta theory of error'
uncertainty: '商羯罗与曼陀纳辩论'的传说未见于本包已核段落，不写

claim: 伐差斯帕底·弥湿罗（9世纪，IEP）是曼陀纳的有影响弟子，作《Bhāmatī》调和两家，此后商羯罗之学走显
locator: 维基："Only when Vacaspati Misra, an influential student of Maṇḍana Miśra, harmonised the teachings of Shankara with those of Maṇḍana Miśra, Shankara's teachings gained prominence"；维基 Writings 节："wrote the Bhamati, a commentary on Shankara's Brahma Sutra Bhashya, and the Brahmatattva-samiksa"；IEP："Vacaspati Miśra's (ninth century) commentary on Śaṅkara's Brahma Sūtra Bhāṣya"
uncertainty: 伐差斯帕底自己的生卒区间本包来源未细载，只取 IEP'9世纪'

claim: 波陀摩帕陀约公元800年，商羯罗最早学生（IEP：'said to be his earliest student'），《Pañcapādikā》疏梵经注开篇
locator: 维基 sub-schools 节："Padmapada (c. 800 CE)"；IEP："Padmapāda is said to be his earliest student. Panchapadika, by Padmapāda, is a lucid commentary on Śaṅkara's commentary on the first verses of the Brahma Sūtra"；SEP：Padmapāda 与 Sureśvara 为 direct disciples
note: IEP 另录波陀摩帕陀基底的论点："adhyāsa without a substratum has never been experienced and is inconceivable"
uncertainty: '最早学生'系 IEP 'said to be' 口径

claim: 苏雷什瓦罗为商羯罗亲传弟子；传统归属《Naiṣkarmya-siddhi》；现代有观点认为唯他忠实代表商羯罗
locator: SEP："An unbroken lineage beginning with Śaṅkara's direct disciples, such as Padmapāda and Sureśvara"；IEP："Sureśvara is supposed to have written Naiṣkarmya Siddhi"；维基："Some modern Advaitins argue that... only his student Suresvara... represents Shankara correctly"
uncertainty: 《Naiṣkarmya-siddhi》归属为传统口径（IEP 'supposed to'），works 条目已注明

claim: 维底罗尼耶（14世纪）任 Śṛṅgeri Śārada Pīṭha 法席（1380—1386）并为维查耶纳伽尔重臣；不二论历史声名在其时代确立
locator: 维基 Vidyāraṇya 节："Vidyāraṇya, also known as Madhava, who was the Jagadguru of the Śringeri Śarada Pītham from 1380 to 1386 and a minister in the Vijayanagara Empire"；"It is only during this period that the historical fame and cultural influence of Shankara and Advaita Vedanta was established"；IEP 后期人物名单列"Vidyāraņya (fourteenth century)"

claim: 论敌指控链：Bhāskara（9世纪，Bhedābheda）斥'māyāvāda'；罗摩奴阇（12世纪）指'prachanna bauddha'（隐蔽佛教徒）；摩陀婆专驳不二论
locator: 维基 Criticisms 节："Bhāskara, a Hindu philosopher of the Bhedabheda Vedānta school (9th century CE), accused Śaṅkara's Advaita tradition as 'this despicable broken down Māyāvāda that has been chanted by the Mahāyāna Buddhists'"；"Rāmāṉuja... similarly accused Ādi Śaṅkara of being a Prachanna Bauddha, that is, a 'crypto-Buddhist'"；Dvaita 节："Madhvacharya wrote four major texts, including Upadhikhandana and Tattvadyota, primarily dedicated to criticizing Advaita"
note: SEP §3 从学说侧印证：无明问题引发'来自罗摩奴阇 Viśiṣṭādvaita 与摩陀婆 Dvaita 的哲学批评'
uncertainty: 维基本页称摩陀婆为14世纪（I05 包口径为 1199—1278 或 1238—1317）；本包时间线写'13—14世纪'并注明该页口径

claim: Bhāmatī 系：jīva 为无明载体与对象；梵只能作为 īśvara 调御无明；本体论取向
locator: IEP："According to the Bhamati School, the jīva is the locus and object of avidya... Brahman can never be the locus of avidya but is the controller of it as īśvara"；维基："The Bhamati school takes an ontological approach. It sees the Jiva as the source of avidya. It sees contemplation as the main factor in the acquirement of liberation"

claim: Vivaraṇa 系：Prakāśātman 注波陀摩帕陀《Pañcapādikā》得名；brahman 为无明载体；首倡 mūlāvidyā'实有而无始'
locator: IEP："the Vivarana School is named after Prakāṣātman's commentary on Padmapāda's Pañcapadika... According to the Vivarana School, Brahman is the locus of avidya"；维基："Prakasatman (c. 1200–1300) wrote the Pancapadika-Vivarana... Prakasatman was the first to propound the theory of mulavidya or maya as being of 'positive beginningless nature'... Critics object that Brahman is pure consciousness, so it cannot be the source of avidya"
note: IEP 前后矛盾句（一处称 Vivaraṇa 为 Vacaspati 作）未采信，已入 evidenceLimits
uncertainty: Prakāśātman 年代：IEP 作10世纪 vs 维基 c. 1200—1300

claim: 商羯罗身后无明问题成为内部争论焦点：载体在个体还是梵、遮与投二力等
locator: SEP Shankara §3 末："Is the locus of ignorance in the individual or brahman? Is ignorance simply misapprehension or does it have a two-fold power of covering and projection?... Such questions have caused several intra-Advaita debates"
note: SEP 注明参见 Potter 1981、Ingalls 1953（'Śaṃkara on the Question: Whose Is avidyā?'）等

claim: Bhāmatī 与 Vivaraṇa 两派成型于11—14世纪；两派致力推演不二论诸说的逻辑结论，核心是 māyā/avidyā 的进一步解释
locator: 维基 sub-schools 节："The still existing Bhāmatī and Vivarana developed in the 11th–14th century"；"These schools worked out the logical implications of various Advaita doctrines. Two of the problems they encountered were the further interpretations of the concepts of māyā and avidya"
note: 维基同节：已消亡的 Pañcapādikā 与 Iṣṭasiddhi 两派被 Prakāśātman 的 Vivaraṇa 系取代

claim: Śaṅkaravijaya 类传记成书于商羯罗身后数百年（14—17世纪）；四道院叙事在14世纪前无文献提及（Hacker）
locator: 维基："Hagiographical accounts of his life, the Śaṅkaravijayas ('Conquests of Śaṅkara'), were composed several centuries after his death... in the 14th to 17th century"；Mathas 节："according to Paul Hacker, no mention of the mathas can be found before the 14th century CE... these mathas may have originated as late as the 14th century"
note: 维基 Mathas 节录传统口径（四 amnāya maṭha：西 Dvārakā、东 Jagannatha Puri、南 Sringeri、北 Badrikashrama，四弟子为首任主持）与 Hacker 考证并陈，本包两说均记、以'叙事/传统'定性
uncertainty: SEP 对道院的表述（'four or five principle monasteries'，引 Cenkner 1983）不系创立于商羯罗，与 Hacker 口径相容

claim: 19世纪西方学术经《Sarvadarśanasaṅgraha》过度强调不二论地位
locator: 维基："In the 19th century, due to the influence of Vidyaranya's Sarvadarśanasaṅgraha, the importance of Advaita Vedānta was overemphasized by Western scholarship, and Advaita Vedānta came to be regarded as the paradigmatic example of Hindu spirituality, despite the numerical dominance of theistic Bhakti-oriented [traditions]"
note: SEP 书目侧证商羯罗声名的接受史成分：Mayeda 引 Deussen 之赞后商羯罗'通常被视为印度最伟大哲学家'

claim: GRETIL《Āgamaśāstra》文本实存并核读：GpK_2.31—2.32 原文
locator: GRETIL 文件头（录入 Peter Schreiner，版本 2020-07-31，底本 Apate, Pune 1921, Anandasrama Sanskrit Series 10）；GpK_2.31："svapnamāye yathā dṛṣṭe gandharvanagaraṃ yathā / tathā viśvam idaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vedānteṣu vicakṣaṇaiḥ"；GpK_2.32："na nirodho na cotpattir na baddho na ca sādhakaḥ / na mumukṣur na vai mukta ity eṣā paramārthatā"
note: 本包 quote 与 closingQuote 均取自该文件亲读原文；GpK_3.10（"saṃghātāḥ svapnavat sarve ātmamāyāvisarjitāḥ"）亦核读
uncertainty: GRETIL 明文本存在个别 [check!] 标记（如 GpK_3.9），所引 2.31/2.32 节无此标记

claim: GRETIL《薄伽梵歌》+注文本实存并核读；标题作'commentary ascribed to Śaṃkara'且仅含 1—17 章；BG 2.16 颂与商羯罗注原文
locator: GRETIL 文件头："Bhagavadgītā with the commentary ascribed to Śaṃkara (Adhyāyas 1-17)"；||bhg_2.16|| 颂文与注（详见 /school/overview 条目）
note: 真伪研究另引 Mayeda 1965（经 SEP 书目："The Authenticity of the Bhagavadgītābhāṣya Ascribed to Śaṅkara"）
uncertainty: GRETIL 'ascribed'措辞与仅含1—17章的覆盖范围，已入 evidenceLimits

claim: 商羯罗《梵经注》为现存最早完整注疏，开篇叠加注专论误认
locator: SEP："He composed our earliest complete extant commentaries on the Brahmasūtras..."；"Śaṅkara's seminal discussion of superimposition in his introduction to the BrSū titled, the 'Commentary on Superimposition' [Adhyāsabhāṣya]"；IEP："his preamble to the commentary on the Brahma Sūtra"
note: 《梵经》原典明文本本包未核读（I04 包已核），经义经 SEP/IEP 引述层使用

claim: 《Upadeśasāhasrī》为商羯罗唯一确定的独立著作，Mayeda 校译并考证其真实性
locator: SEP："Śaṅkara also composed an independent work titled the Upadeśasāhasrī (A Thousand Teachings)"；书目：Mayeda 1965b "The Authenticity of the Upadeśasāhasrī Ascribed to Śaṅkara"、Mayeda 1992 "A Thousand Teachings"；维基："his most important original philosophical work"

claim: 十主要奥义书注的十部名目；学者普遍视为商羯罗真作；Māṇḍūkya 注与乔荼波陀 Kārikā 注合为一体
locator: SEP："the ten principal Upaniṣads consisting of the Īṣā, Kena, Kaṭha, Praṣna, Muṇḍaka, Māṇḍūkya, Aitareya, Taittirīya, Chāndogya, and Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upanisads. Śaṅkara's commentary on the Māṇḍukya is part of his extensive commentary on the Gauḍapādakārikās' explanation of the Māṇḍūkya"；维基 Writings 节："His commentaries on ten Mukhya (principal) Upanishads are also considered authentic by scholars"
note: SEP 同时警示：'数百部托名商羯罗的著作真伪存疑，多出自后世持 Śaṅkarācārya 称号者之手'（引 Potter/Hacker/Mayeda）

claim: 曼陀纳《Brahma-siddhi》的错误论成为规范不二论错误论；与另三部并称四 siddhi
locator: 维基 Maṇḍana 节："the 'theory of error' set forth in the Brahma-siddhi became the normative Advaita Vedanta theory of error"；维基 Vimuktatman 节："It is one of the four traditional siddhi, together with Mandana's Brahma-siddhi, Suresvara's Naiskarmya-siddhi, and Madusudana's Advaita-siddhi"
note: IEP 补充：曼陀纳版本的不二论聚焦 sphoṭa 语义理论（Bhartṛhari 的语言哲学）

claim: 波陀摩帕陀《Pañcapādikā》为疏梵经注开篇的注释
locator: IEP："a lucid commentary on Śaṅkara's commentary on the first verses of the Brahma Sūtra"；维基："The Vivarana School is named after Prakāṣātman's (tenth century) commentary on Padmapāda's Pañcapadika, which itself is a commentary on Śaṅkara's commentary on the Brahma Sūtra"

claim: 'tat tvam asi'（ChU 6.8.7）与 anvaya-vyatireka 释义
locator: SEP Shankara §5："'You are that' (ChU 6.8.7: tat tvam asi)... tvam negates the mediacy of tat as existence external to one's Self. And tat negates any subjective limitations to the consciousness referred to in tvam"
note: 经文位置（ChU 6.8.7）经 SEP 条目核读转引；《歌者奥义书》原典本包未另行核读，故 kind 标'经 SEP 核读转引'

claim: 'brahma satyam jagan mithyā'韵文系匿名传诵，不署名商羯罗
locator: IEP §History 前导节："These cardinal doctrines are represented in the anonymous verse 'brahma satyam jagan mithya; jīvo brahmaiva na aparah'"
note: IEP 明言 anonymous verse；本包署名栏如实写'匿名传诵韵文'

claim: 中世纪晚期不二论吸收瑜伽传统与《Yoga-Vāsiṣṭha》等；维底罗尼耶受（略本）Yoga-Vāsiṣṭha 影响
locator: 维基 Late medieval 节："the living Advaita Vedānta tradition in medieval times was influenced by, and incorporated elements from, the yogic tradition and texts like the Yoga Vasistha and the Bhagavata Purana"；"Vidyāraṇya (14th century) was influenced by the (Laghu-)Yoga-Vasistha"
note: 同节引 Allen/Venkatkrishnan：商羯罗研究充分而其身后数百年不二论史'尚无哪怕初步的全面叙述'——本包时间线覆盖范围以此为度

claim: 起读路线一的作品次第（Upadeśasāhasrī → 梵经注叠加注 → Kārikā 第二品）各文本真实存在且本包来源可及
locator: SEP Works 段与 §3（Adhyāsabhāṣya）；GRETIL S4（GpK_2.31—2.36 在线可核）；Mayeda 1992 译本经 SEP 书目

claim: 对中观与唯识自证说的具体论辩：商羯罗斥中观式的'无基论'为反直觉的虚无主义；斥唯识/自证说的'认知自照'为自反悖论
locator: SEP Shankara §2.1："He considers this latter position, which he construes as the Madhyamika Buddhist, to be counter-intuitively nihilistic (see ChUbh 6.2.1–2)"；§3："Śaṅkara also critiques the view of some Mahāyāna Buddhist philosophers, Vasubandhu and Dharmakīrti... A cognition reveal... just as a knife cannot cut itself (BrSūBh 2.2.28)"
note: 写入 overview 第2/4段的论辩层；对佛教立场的概括均转述 SEP 对商羯罗立场的表述，不代述佛教

claim: 无明载体之争无无争议裁决；'世界为幻'承受虚无主义误读压力
locator: SEP §3 末列无明诸问（见前条）；IEP §Error：错觉对象'neither real nor unreal'与解脱之我'真实且确定'的对照；维基 Criticisms 节：Bhāskara 以降的 māyāvāda 指控即冲此而来

claim: 商羯罗'印度哲学顶峰'形象有接受史成分（Deussen 之赞；《Sarvadarśanasaṅgraha》的过度强调）
locator: 维基："it is only since Deussen's praise that Shankara 'has usually been regarded as the greatest philosopher of India'"（引 Mayeda）；19世纪 Western scholarship 过度强调条（见 timeline/8 条目）
